hints.title: Grammar of Subtree Parentheses
hints.text: A tree node is followed by parentheses enclosing its left child subtree, optionally followed by parentheses for its right child.

hints.title: Parentheses Balance Splitting
hints.text: Parse the root value up to the first open parenthesis. Then count matching parentheses to extract the left child and right child substrings.

hints.title: Divide-and-Conquer Tree Deserialization
hints.text: If string is empty, return None. Find index of first parenthesis. Substring up to that index is root value. Scan with a paren balance counter from first open paren: when counter reaches 0, the enclosed slice forms left subtree, and remaining enclosed slice forms right subtree.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: length of input string s
complexity.notes: Substring slicing and recursive depth tree creation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Parsing without tracking balance fails on nested child expressions.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Parentheses balance scan partitions left and right subtrees with minimal state.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Locate balanced parenthesized blocks to recursively build the tree.
